name: Smidt first-principles ferroelectric candidate database
description: Symmetry-paired polar and nonpolar structures with computed polarization paths and electronic properties.
count_scope: 255 completed candidate workflows; 200 pass the paper’s high-quality assessment and 126 are newly proposed within that subset.

sources.title: Smidt et al., Scientific Data 7, 72
sources.evidence: Paper reports 255 successfully completed pairs after screening over 67,000 MP materials; provides atomic structures, VASP files, polarization and energies.

sources.title: Ferroelectric data deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Version 4 provides distortions.json.gz, workflow_data.json.gz and per-workflow VASP archives under CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Candidate ferroelectricity is a computational designation; it does not establish experimental switching.
Overlaps Materials Project structures; the 255 pairs are not 510 unique materials.
The paper’s metadata-only Figshare record 11702073 is distinct from the actual data deposit.

name: Ricci polar-material ferroelectric screening dataset
description: Pseudosymmetry-generated nonpolar references and DFT polarization screening of polar Materials Project compounds.
count_scope: Paper reports polarization calculations for 447 polar materials; 1,978 initial structures were screened and a ranked subset contains 182 potential ferroelectrics.
license: CC BY 4.0 (paper and its supplementary tables)

sources.title: Ricci et al., Candidate ferroelectrics via ab initio high-throughput screening of polar materials
sources.evidence: Full paper states polarization calculated for 447 materials; data availability identifies manuscript and supplementary tables, and says future MP/API availability.

caveats: Data release is manuscript/supplementary tables; current Materials Project API coverage was not verified.
Structure-linked through parent MP records; standalone atomic coordinate archive not verified.
182 ranked candidates use ΔE of 1–200 meV/atom and polarization above 10 µC/cm²; initial-screen denominator 1,978 is not a count of successful polarization labels.
Overlaps the Smidt search and Materials Project; do not add counts as independent crystals.

name: Trinquet nonlinear-optical SHG tensor dataset
description: Static second-harmonic generation and electronic dielectric tensors computed for inorganic semiconductor crystals.
count_scope: 579 noncentrosymmetric inorganic semiconductors in the released computed database.

sources.title: Materials Cloud 2024.87
sources.evidence: Open CC BY 4.0 record supplies nlodb.json, README and rotation code for 579 inorganic semiconductors.

sources.title: Trinquet et al., Scientific Data 11, 757
sources.evidence: ABINIT LDA/DFPT static conventional SHG and electronic dielectric tensors; MPContribs supplies associated pymatgen Structure.

caveats: Static electronic response excludes frequency dispersion and ionic contributions.
LDA band gap errors can inflate SHG components; ranking does not prove device performance.
The same dataset is mirrored at Materials Cloud, UCLouvain Dataverse and MPContribs; count once.
Parent structures overlap MP and earlier optical semiconductor cohorts.

name: Fang Wannier optical and transport tensors
description: Structure-resolved optical conductivity, shift-current and electronic transport tensors from Wannier Hamiltonians.
count_scope: 7,301 entries passing Wannier spread and band interpolation quality criteria.
license: CC BY 4.0 (Figshare data; article has a separate CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license)

sources.title: Fang et al., Scientific Data 12, 1092
sources.evidence: Describes 7,301 materials with per-material structures, first-principles/Wannier bands, optical tensors at 0–2.5 eV and transport at 100–1000 K.

sources.title: Wannier dataset deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Deposit v1 offers data.zip and explicitly declares CC BY 4.0 for the dataset.

caveats: Transport uses intrinsic Fermi level and constant relaxation time of 10 fs; it does not represent doped optimization.
Thermal conductivity is electronic only; reported zT excludes lattice conductivity and is not full experimental thermoelectric zT.
MP source structures overlap the parent database; tensor components/temperature samples are not extra crystals.

name: ChemDataExtractor semiconductor band-gap database
description: Literature-extracted semiconductor band gaps with chemical identifiers, temperature and source provenance.
count_scope: 100,236 property records extracted from 128,776 papers; 21,053 unique chemical names. Includes 7,656 manually curated BandgapDB records.

sources.title: Dong and Cole, Scientific Data 9, 193
sources.evidence: Reports 100,236 non-computational band-gap records; CSV, JSON and MongoDB include temperatures, source DOIs and sentences. Reported weighted precision is 84% and recall 65%.

sources.title: CDE band-gap deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Figshare v1 supplies Bandpgap_database_v2.zip and code_v2.zip under MIT.

caveats: Composition/chemical-name labels are not periodic structures or phase-resolved crystal identifiers.
Not all semiconductor records are inorganic crystalline solids; filter source context before crystal-only use.
Repeated conditions, aliases and literature reports are multiple records, not unique materials.
Overlaps BandgapDB by construction; automatic extraction can introduce assignment errors.

name: ChemDataExtractor refractive-index and dielectric database
description: Literature-mined refractive index and dielectric constant records with conditions and source provenance.
count_scope: 49,076 refractive-index records plus 60,804 dielectric-constant records on 11,054 unique chemicals; not a crystal count.
properties: frequency and dielectric loss when reported

sources.title: Zhao and Cole, Scientific Data 9, 192
sources.evidence: Reports separate 49,076/60,804 property denominators and 11,054 chemicals; records preserve wavelength, dielectric loss, units and source metadata.

sources.title: CDE optical database deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Version 2 supplies JSON, SQL, CSV and code under CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Contains organic and inorganic chemicals and is not restricted to crystals; no atomic structures.
Never treat the total as 109,880 independent materials or assume each record has both properties.
Frequency, wavelength, specimen and extraction warning flags matter for comparing numerical values.
Composition-linked literature data require source review to distinguish phases and resolve extraction errors.

count_derivation.method: separate refractive-index and dielectric records, not unique chemicals

name: Refractiveindex.info optical constants
description: Condition-resolved optical-constant data from publications and materials datasheets in YAML format.
version: December 2023 descriptor snapshot; live repository separately maintained
count_scope: December 2023 descriptor snapshot: 3,135 linear-optical records for 605 materials plus 193 nonlinear-optical records for 89 materials; material populations may overlap.

sources.title: Polyanskiy, Scientific Data 11, 94
sources.evidence: December 2023 snapshot distinguishes linear and nonlinear data records and material counts; YAML records carry publication and conditions.

sources.title: Optical constants database repository
sources.evidence: Maintainer declares database CC0 1.0; YAML data include original references and material details.

caveats: Broad materials scope includes crystals, amorphous solids, liquids and gases; a crystal-only denominator is unverified.
No general atomic structure archive; mixed here indicates phase/specimen-resolved optical records across physical states.
Snapshot count does not claim the live repository size as of 2026.
Experimental and theoretical optical constants may coexist; inspect each original reference and preserve wavelength, temperature and orientation.

count_derivation.method: December 2023 linear + nonlinear optical data records, not disjoint material counts

name: TopoHSE-DB
description: Hybrid-functional topological classifications of nonmagnetic crystalline materials, compared with semilocal calculations.
count_scope: Dataset-level release verified; exact entry count and standalone atomic coordinate coverage were not verified.

sources.title: OpenAlex primary publication metadata
sources.evidence: Verified published article title/authors and abstract: HSE06 and semilocal calculations share relaxed structures and are classified using topological quantum chemistry.

sources.title: TopoHSE-DB data release
sources.evidence: RODARE open dataset published 2026-08-14 provides trace_files.zip under CC BY 2.0; version DOI 10.14278/rodare.4935.

caveats: A separate hybrid-functional computed cohort from existing TQC catalogs; overlap with source crystals remains possible.
Only trace archive availability was directly verified; structure files, count and archive contents were not audited.
Topological classes depend on functional and ideal bulk/symmetry assumptions; experimental topological claims are not equivalent labels.

name: Wurtzite solid-solution PiezoML data
description: DFT structures, screening descriptors and explicit piezoelectric calculations for doped wurtzite solid solutions.
count_scope: Deposit describes >3,000 generated candidates, about 500 proxy-screened candidates, 30 promising selections and 11 enhanced-response predictions; exact released row count unverified.
license: CC0 1.0 (Dryad data terms; bundled software licenses need separate checking)

sources.title: Behrendt et al., Dryad data and code release
sources.evidence: Published 2026-05-28; README lists relaxed base structures, doped calculation directories, finite-strain Berry-phase e33, formation-energy calculations and CSVs. Nine base systems are AlN, BeO, CdS, CdSe, GaN, ZnO, ZnS, ZnSe and AgI.

sources.title: Dryad data terms
sources.evidence: Dryad terms identify CC0 as the data publication license.

caveats: Generated candidates, proxy-screened candidates and explicit e33 calculations have different denominators; total candidate count is not a piezoelectric label count.
README lists 2×2×1 16-atom wurtzite supercells and two cation substitutions.
Some relaxed candidates lose wurtzite structure; failure markers must not be treated as valid computed responses.
Deposit date is 2026; README refers to a 2024 publication without a verified journal DOI.

name: IPOP inorganic phosphor optical-property dataset
description: Literature-curated doped inorganic phosphor observations with experimental optical properties and measurement conditions.
count_scope: 16,023 observations spanning 3,952 host–dopant combinations, 2,238 host materials, 21 dopant elements and 553 articles in v3.

sources.title: Jang et al., Optical property dataset of inorganic phosphor
sources.evidence: Describes v3 composition/host/dopant data, property observations and experimental conditions, with downloadable dataset and feature files.

sources.title: IPOP v3 deposit metadata
sources.evidence: Data deposit licensing and files verified through Figshare metadata.

caveats: Observation counts are not unique crystals and do not imply every observation reports all eight optical targets.
Doped host formulas and measurement conditions do not constitute atomic coordinate structures.
Overlaps earlier IPOP versions; retain v3 as the release record rather than additive versions.

name: EKHI optical and thermal radiative properties
description: Digitized experimental optical and radiative curves for solid specimens with original-publication provenance.
count_scope: 1,251 curves containing 18,999 numerical values for 171 solid materials from 167 primary sources; 16 subproperties within four main properties.

sources.title: Gabirondo-López et al., Scientific Data 13, 740
sources.evidence: Data Records gives 1,251 curves, 18,999 values, 171 solids and 167 accessible original sources; data deposit is CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Scope includes metallic elements/alloys, nonmetallic solids and coatings; crystalline fraction unverified and no atomic coordinates.
Curves have differing temperature, wavelength, measurement geometry and specimen conditions.
Digitizes historical TPRC values; digitization validation does not guarantee original experimental accuracy.
Curve count is not a material count and property coverage is uneven.
